step1: Feet wide, sit like a chair, hold 5 s
step3: Stance, then slide 2 steps each way
step4: Stance, slide, sprint 3 steps, stop back in stance
cues: Sit low; chest up; eyes up
kid_version: Make it 'Statue' game: freeze in stance on 'freeze'
how_it_works: Feet shoulder-width, knees bent, back flat, head up; the base every dribble move starts from.
sources: Online Basketball Playbook, Finishing Moves - https://onlinebasketballplaybook.com/basketball-finishing-moves/ | General coaching practice (no single source; standard youth drill)

step4: Pound while counting fingers a coach holds up (eyes up)
cues: Fingertips not palm; pound it hard; eyes up
prerequisites: A01 Athletic stance (ready position)
kid_version: Size 4 or 5 youth ball; count out loud
how_it_works: Hard, fast dribble at one height beside the body; the ball should 'pop' back into a spread-finger hand.
sources: See The Floor, Dribble Moves glossary - https://seethefloor.com/dribble-moves/ | General coaching practice (no single source; standard youth drill)

step4: Switch heights every 2 dribbles, both hands
cues: Lower = faster; stay in stance
prerequisites: A02 Pound dribble (right / left)
how_it_works: Same pound dribble, switching between high, waist and low on command.
sources: General coaching practice (no single source; standard youth drill)

step2: Low pound, straight up and down
step3: Fastest low pound, ball at the knee
cues: Tiny bounces; soft knees; fingers
prerequisites: A03 Pound ladder (high / medium / low)
how_it_works: Low, hard one-hand dribbles that finish in quick crossovers.
sources: General coaching practice (no single source; standard youth drill)

step4: Taps up and down for 20 s
cues: Fingers only; fast hands
how_it_works: Slap the ball hand to hand, then tap it fingertip to fingertip in front of the face, waist, knees.
sources: General coaching practice (no single source; standard youth drill)

move: Around the world wraps (head, waist, legs)
cues: Hands only, body still; reverse direction
prerequisites: A05 Ball slaps / finger taps
how_it_works: Wrap the ball around the head, waist, then knees without dropping it, both directions.
sources: General coaching practice (no single source; standard youth drill)

cues: Stay low; quick hands
prerequisites: A06 Around the world wraps (head, waist, legs)
how_it_works: Pass the ball around and between the legs in a figure-8 without bouncing.
sources: General coaching practice (no single source; standard youth drill)

step1: Drop ball between legs, catch in front
step2: Bounce through legs, catch behind back
cues: Bounce hard; hands ready behind; knees bent
prerequisites: A07 Figure-8 wrap (no dribble)
how_it_works: Throw the ball hard between the legs off the floor, catch it behind the back, bring it back and repeat; the bullet version starts overhead.

cues: Snap the wrist; off arm up; low
prerequisites: A02 Pound dribble (right / left)
how_it_works: One hand dribbles the ball side to side in front of the body in a V shape.
sources: Online Basketball Drills, Yo-Yo Dribbling Drill - https://www.online-basketball-drills.com/yo-yo-dribbling-drill

step4: Combo: one front V, one side V, repeat
cues: Hand rides the ball; stay low
prerequisites: A10 V-dribble, front (side-to-side yo-yo)
how_it_works: One hand dribbles front to back beside the body.
sources: Online Basketball Drills, Yo-Yo Dribbling Drill - https://www.online-basketball-drills.com/yo-yo-dribbling-drill

step1: Cross once, catch with the other hand
step4: Wide crossovers (push it outside the hip)
cues: Below the knees; wide; eyes up
prerequisites: A10 V-dribble, front (side-to-side yo-yo)
how_it_works: Bounce the ball from one hand to the other in front of the body, below the knees.
sources: See The Floor, Dribble Moves glossary - https://seethefloor.com/dribble-moves/ | General coaching practice (no single source; standard youth drill)

step1: Lunge stance, ball beside front foot
cues: Bounce under the middle; front foot forward; low
prerequisites: A12 Stationary crossover
kid_version: Roll the ball through first if bouncing is hard
how_it_works: Staggered stance, bounce the ball between the legs from one hand to the other; switch feet.
sources: See The Floor, Dribble Moves glossary - https://seethefloor.com/dribble-moves/ | General coaching practice (no single source; standard youth drill)

step4: Behind-back with a small step into it
cues: Push from behind the hip; step into it; eyes up
prerequisites: A12 Stationary crossover
how_it_works: Push the ball behind the back hip to land beside the other foot.
sources: Patriot League, Defining 'The Cooz' - https://patriotleague.org/news/2008/12/25/Defining_The_Cooz_.aspx

cues: Low dribbles; wide stance
prerequisites: A07 Figure-8 wrap (no dribble); A13 Stationary between the legs
how_it_works: Dribble around and between the legs in a figure-8.
sources: General coaching practice (no single source; standard youth drill)

step4: Lie back and up while dribbling
cues: Fingertips; quick little bounces
how_it_works: Dribble while kneeling or sitting, around the body.
sources: General coaching practice (no single source; standard youth drill)

cues: Hand on the side of the ball; wrist turns it back out; same hand, no carry
prerequisites: A10 V-dribble, front (side-to-side yo-yo); A12 Stationary crossover
kid_version: Say 'in... and out' out loud; slow and big first
how_it_works: Fake a crossover with one hand: push the ball toward the middle, turn the wrist over and bring it back out on the same side. Feet stay put.
sources: See The Floor, Dribble Moves glossary - https://seethefloor.com/dribble-moves/ | Coach's Clipboard, Full-Court Dribble Moves Drill - https://www.coachesclipboard.net/DribblingMovesDrill.html

cues: Push it ahead; waist high; head up
prerequisites: A02 Pound dribble (right / left)
how_it_works: Push the ball out ahead of you waist-high and run to it; head up.
sources: Coach's Clipboard, Dribbling and Dribble Moves - https://www.coachesclipboard.net/Dribbling.html | See The Floor, Dribble Moves glossary - https://seethefloor.com/dribble-moves/

cues: Body between ball and defender; low
prerequisites: A02 Pound dribble (right / left)
kid_version: Parent gently reaches for the ball
how_it_works: Low dribble on the side away from the defender, off arm up as a bar.
sources: Online Basketball Drills, Yo-Yo Dribbling Drill - https://www.online-basketball-drills.com/yo-yo-dribbling-drill | General coaching practice (no single source; standard youth drill)

cues: Stay low; ball on hip side
prerequisites: B02 Control / protect dribble
aliases: escape dribble, back out, drag dribble
how_it_works: Two quick backward slides while dribbling to escape pressure, then re-attack.
sources: See The Floor, Dribble Moves glossary - https://seethefloor.com/dribble-moves/

step4: Full speed crossover, 2 hard dribbles past chair
cues: Plant outside foot; cross low; push off
prerequisites: A12 Stationary crossover; B01 Speed dribble
how_it_works: Change of direction dribble from one hand to the other in front of the body, plant the outside foot, push off.
sources: Championship Productions, Collection of ballhandling drills - https://www.championshipproductions.com/cgi-bin/champ/basketball-drills/dc/Collection-of-ballhandling-drills-34.html | See The Floor, Dribble Moves glossary - https://seethefloor.com/dribble-moves/

cues: Fake with shoulders; same hand; don't carry
prerequisites: A21 Stationary in-and-out; B04 Crossover (on the move)
how_it_works: Fake a crossover by bringing the ball inward then back out with the same hand, keeping the hand on the side of the ball.
sources: See The Floor, Dribble Moves glossary - https://seethefloor.com/dribble-moves/ | Coach's Clipboard, Full-Court Dribble Moves Drill - https://www.coachesclipboard.net/DribblingMovesDrill.html

cues: Sell with eyes and shoulders; hand on top of the ball; explode
prerequisites: B01 Speed dribble
how_it_works: Change of pace: attack fast, stop short, rock back as if stopping or shooting, then explode by with the same hand. Rise up, sell it with your eyes, keep the hips low, push the ball ahead.
sources: Online Basketball Playbook, Hesitation Dribble - https://onlinebasketballplaybook.com/basketball-hesitation-dribble/ | Coach's Clipboard, Dribbling and Dribble Moves - https://www.coachesclipboard.net/Dribbling.html

cues: Slow is a weapon; big push on the burst
prerequisites: B01 Speed dribble
how_it_works: Throttle down to lull the defender, then a sudden first step and push dribble.
sources: Bleacher Report, Breaking Down the Signature Moves of NBA's Top Stars (2020) - https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2905683

cues: Quick feet; low hips; then explode
prerequisites: B01 Speed dribble
how_it_works: Fast choppy feet while dribbling to freeze the defender before going.
sources: See The Floor, Dribble Moves glossary - https://seethefloor.com/dribble-moves/ | Coach's Clipboard, Full-Court Dribble Moves Drill - https://www.coachesclipboard.net/DribblingMovesDrill.html

step3: Skip, snatch ball back, wrap around waist
step4: Skip, snatch, wrap, pass to wall target
cues: Soft bounce; rhythm in feet; snatch quick
prerequisites: A06 Around the world wraps (head, waist, legs); A02 Pound dribble (right / left)
how_it_works: Bounce the ball in front and skip/shuffle the feet as if not paying attention; when the defender reaches, snatch it back, wrap it around the waist, and pass.

step4: Full speed between-legs change of direction at chair
cues: Bounce as front foot lands; low
prerequisites: A13 Stationary between the legs; B04 Crossover (on the move)
how_it_works: Change hands through the legs as the lead foot steps forward.
sources: See The Floor, Dribble Moves glossary - https://seethefloor.com/dribble-moves/ | Coach's Clipboard, Full-Court Dribble Moves Drill - https://www.coachesclipboard.net/DribblingMovesDrill.html

step4: Full speed behind-back change of direction
cues: Body ahead of ball; pull with wrist; eyes up
prerequisites: A14 Stationary behind the back; B04 Crossover (on the move)
how_it_works: Wrap the ball behind the back while moving to change hands and direction, body shielding the ball.
sources: Championship Productions, Collection of ballhandling drills - https://www.championshipproductions.com/cgi-bin/champ/basketball-drills/dc/Collection-of-ballhandling-drills-34.html | Patriot League, Defining 'The Cooz' - https://patriotleague.org/news/2008/12/25/Defining_The_Cooz_.aspx

cues: Pull the ball with you; tight spin; eyes find the rim fast
prerequisites: F03 Front pivot; B04 Crossover (on the move)
how_it_works: Plant the inside foot, spin away from the defender pulling the ball tight to the hip, change hands, come out squared. Time it for when the defender leans or reaches.
sources: Bleacher Report, Breaking Down the Signature Moves of NBA's Top Stars (2020) - https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2905683 | Championship Productions, Collection of ballhandling drills - https://www.championshipproductions.com/cgi-bin/champ/basketball-drills/dc/Collection-of-ballhandling-drills-34.html | Athletic Officials, So You Think That's A Travel (NFHS rules) - https://www.athletic-officials.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/So-You-Think-Thats-A-Travel.pdf

step4: Drive, half spin, spin back, go
cues: Sell the spin with the shoulder; stay low
prerequisites: B12 Spin move
how_it_works: Start the spin, stop halfway, spin back the original way.
sources: See The Floor, Dribble Moves glossary - https://seethefloor.com/dribble-moves/ | Hoops Playbook, Skills Checklist - Finishing - http://www.hoopsplaybook.ca/notes/skills_finishing.htm

step2: Hang the ball on top for a beat
cues: Hand on top; pause the body; then go
prerequisites: B06 Hesitation (hesi) / rocker
how_it_works: Ride the ball on top of the hand for a beat to freeze the defender, then go.
sources: See The Floor, Dribble Moves glossary - https://seethefloor.com/dribble-moves/ | Basketnews, Top 10 ball handlers of all time - https://basketnews.com/news-218763-best-ball-handlers-of-all-time.html

cues: Ball tight; feet retreat with the ball
prerequisites: B03 Retreat dribble
how_it_works: Drive, then pull the ball back while the feet retreat to create space when the defender overcommits.
sources: See The Floor, Snatch Back - https://seethefloor.com/glossary/snatch-back/

step1: Push ball out, catch with same hand
step2: Push out, pull back with other hand (no feet)
step3: Add footwork: short step, long step
step4: Full speed push-pull cross at chair
cues: Sell the toss; light drop not a pound; explode out
prerequisites: B04 Crossover (on the move); B15 Snatch back
how_it_works: Push the ball far out with one hand as if lost, then pull it back across the body with the other hand as the defender lunges; long step, explode.

step2: Push wide, freeze 1 count, cross back
cues: Push it wide; freeze the ball; low and fast back
prerequisites: B04 Crossover (on the move); B06 Hesitation (hesi) / rocker
how_it_works: Push the ball wide and hold it still a split second to sell the drive, then snap it back across low and fast.
sources: Legends Clothing Co., Top 25 Best Handles in NBA History - https://www.legendssf.com/blogs/legends-blog/top-10-best-handles-in-nba-history

step4: Full speed double cross at chair
cues: Both crosses low; second one faster
prerequisites: B04 Crossover (on the move)
how_it_works: Two crossovers in a row (right-left-right) to make the defender commit, then accelerate.
sources: Championship Productions, Collection of ballhandling drills - https://www.championshipproductions.com/cgi-bin/champ/basketball-drills/dc/Collection-of-ballhandling-drills-34.html | See The Floor, Dribble Moves glossary - https://seethefloor.com/dribble-moves/

step4: Full speed at chair, 2 hard dribbles past
cues: Stay low; sell with shoulders; cross below the knee
prerequisites: B04 Crossover (on the move); B10 Between the legs (on the move)
how_it_works: Low, hard between-the-legs dribble (usually R to L) with a weight shift to sell the drive; when the defender reacts, immediate crossover back to the right and burst.
sources: ESPN, The NBA's best signature moves - https://www.espn.com/espn/feature/story/_/id/24504198/

cues: Rhythm then freeze; last cross lowest and fastest
prerequisites: B17 Hesi-hold crossover; B10 Between the legs (on the move)
how_it_works: Crossover, between-the-legs back, the hold/lean, then a final low crossover into a pull-up.

cues: Same height both dribbles
prerequisites: B04 Crossover (on the move); B10 Between the legs (on the move)
how_it_works: Crossover then immediate between-the-legs back.
sources: Coach's Clipboard, Full-Court Dribble Moves Drill - https://www.coachesclipboard.net/DribblingMovesDrill.html | General coaching practice (no single source; standard youth drill)

move: Between the legs into behind the back
cues: Low; step with each move
prerequisites: B10 Between the legs (on the move); B11 Behind the back (on the move)
how_it_works: Between-the-legs then behind-the-back.
sources: General coaching practice (no single source; standard youth drill)

cues: Push behind hip; eyes up
prerequisites: B04 Crossover (on the move); B11 Behind the back (on the move)
how_it_works: Crossover then behind-the-back to switch back.
sources: General coaching practice (no single source; standard youth drill)

step4: Chain all three nonstop, explode out
cues: Same rhythm every dribble; eyes up
prerequisites: C03 Cross into between the legs; C04 Between the legs into behind the back
how_it_works: Drill the simple moves relentlessly, then string them into one nonstop combination: crossover, between the legs, behind the back.
sources: Legends Clothing Co., Top 25 Best Handles in NBA History - https://www.legendssf.com/blogs/legends-blog/top-10-best-handles-in-nba-history | Basketnews, Top 10 ball handlers of all time - https://basketnews.com/news-218763-best-ball-handlers-of-all-time.html

cues: Sell the first fake hard
prerequisites: B05 In-and-out; B04 Crossover (on the move)
how_it_works: Fake the crossover with an in-and-out, then actually cross.
sources: Coach's Clipboard, Full-Court Dribble Moves Drill - https://www.coachesclipboard.net/DribblingMovesDrill.html

cues: Freeze them, then go opposite
prerequisites: B06 Hesitation (hesi) / rocker; B04 Crossover (on the move)
how_it_works: Hesitation to stand the defender up, then crossover the other way.
sources: Coach's Clipboard, Dribbling and Dribble Moves - https://www.coachesclipboard.net/Dribbling.html | Coach's Clipboard, Full-Court Dribble Moves Drill - https://www.coachesclipboard.net/DribblingMovesDrill.html

cues: Fast feet, then low cross
prerequisites: B08 Stutter step; B04 Crossover (on the move)
how_it_works: Stutter feet then crossover and burst.
sources: Coach's Clipboard, Full-Court Dribble Moves Drill - https://www.coachesclipboard.net/DribblingMovesDrill.html

step2: Ball fake one way (no release) then behind-back
cues: Sell the shake with eyes and shoulders; low; explode
prerequisites: B11 Behind the back (on the move); B05 In-and-out
how_it_works: A fake (the shake) into a behind-the-back (the bake) to blow by. Sell the fake with your eyes and shoulders.
sources: Legends Clothing Co., Top 25 Best Handles in NBA History - https://www.legendssf.com/blogs/legends-blog/top-10-best-handles-in-nba-history

cues: Create space, then change direction
prerequisites: B15 Snatch back; B04 Crossover (on the move)
how_it_works: Snatch back then crossover to re-attack the other way.
sources: See The Floor, Snatch Back - https://seethefloor.com/glossary/snatch-back/

cues: Plant hard before the spin
prerequisites: B04 Crossover (on the move); B12 Spin move
how_it_works: Crossover to get the defender sliding, then spin back.
sources: General coaching practice (no single source; standard youth drill)

step1: Walk it slow: hesi-hold cross, killer crossover, spin
step2: Walk it slow: shake and bake, push-pull cross, three-move chain
step3: Half speed: all 6 moves at 3 chairs, no stops
step4: Game speed: all 6 moves nonstop, then explode
cues: Same speed at every chair; head up
prerequisites: C06 Three-move chain (cross, between, behind); C10 Shake and Bake; B17 Hesi-hold crossover; C01 Killer crossover; B12 Spin move; B16 Push-pull crossover
how_it_works: Chain six learned moves across three chairs, finishing at game speed: hesi-hold cross, killer crossover, spin, shake and bake, push-pull cross, three-move chain.
sources: General coaching practice (no single source; standard youth drill)

step2: Jog with ball held, jump stop
cues: Land on two at once; low; balanced
prerequisites: A01 Athletic stance (ready position)
how_it_works: Land on both feet at once; either foot can become the pivot.
sources: Athletic Officials, So You Think That's A Travel (NFHS rules) - https://www.athletic-officials.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/So-You-Think-Thats-A-Travel.pdf | Online Basketball Playbook, Finishing Moves - https://onlinebasketballplaybook.com/basketball-finishing-moves/

cues: Pivot on the ball of the foot; stay low
prerequisites: F01 Jump stop
how_it_works: Keep the pivot foot down and step forward around it.
sources: Athletic Officials, So You Think That's A Travel (NFHS rules) - https://www.athletic-officials.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/So-You-Think-Thats-A-Travel.pdf
